name: Foul Language
overview: Scripture commands believers to honor God's name and warns against taking it in vain, emphasizing the seriousness of our speech (Exodus 20:7). Jesus teaches that every idle word will be accounted for on the day of judgment, highlighting the eternal significance of our words (Matthew 12:36-37). Accordingly, Christians are called to avoid corrupt, filthy, or foolish talk, instead using speech that edifies and ministers grace to others (Ephesians 4:29; 5:4). This instruction underscores the responsibility to communicate in a manner that reflects thanksgiving and reverence toward God.
